summary: Tyra Biosciences filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing an underwriting agreement dated September 14, 2026 with Jefferies, Guggenheim, Cantor Fitzgerald and Barclays for a public offering of 9,079,000 common shares at $22.03 and 9,078,529 pre-funded warrants at $22.029 (strike $0.001), gross proceeds about $400.0M; underwriting price $20.7082/$20.7072 per share/warrant. Closing expected September 15, 2026. No board recommendation or premium stated. Pre-funded warrant exercise is capped by 4.99%/9.99%/19.99% beneficial-ownership blockers, adjustable to 19.99% with 61 days' notice. Watch dilution, overhang and pricing versus market.
